description: Per-service dev logs (_tools/logs.sh run/mark/since) + live browser viewer and one-line-per-record CLI
setup: Start each dev service through _tools/logs.sh run <svc> <cmd...> (e.g. in .vscode/tasks.json) so it writes .logs/<svc>.log
Optional: add an IDE task for node _tools/logs-viewer/server.mjs (port LOGS_PORT, default 8199)
After each service has logged once, run the log-format-onboard skill so its lines get categorized
